sanskrit_shloka:
नित्याभ्यासादृते प्राप्तिर्न भवेत्सच्चिदात्मनः।
तस्माद्ब्रह्म निदिध्यासेज्जिज्ञासुः श्रेयसे चिरम्।।101।।
text:
नित्याभ्यासादृते प्राप्तिर्न भवेत्सच्चिदात्मनः।
तस्माद्ब्रह्म निदिध्यासेज्जिज्ञासुः श्रेयसे चिरम्।।101।।
transliteration:
Nityābhyāsādṛte prāptirna bhavetsaccidātmanaḥ.
Tasmādbrahma nididhyāsejjijñāsuḥ śreyase ciram..101..
summary_line: The Atman that is absolute existence and knowledge cannot be realized without constant practice. So one seeking after knowledge should long meditate upon Brahman for the attainment of the desired goal.

यमो हि नियमस्त्यागो मौनं देशश्च कालतः।
आसनं मूलबन्धश्च देहसाम्यं च दृक्स्थितिः।।102।।
text:
यमो हि नियमस्त्यागो मौनं देशश्च कालतः।
आसनं मूलबन्धश्च देहसाम्यं च दृक्स्थितिः।।102।।
transliteration:
Yamo hi niyamastyāgo maunaṃ deśaśca kālataḥ.
Āsanaṃ mūlabandhaśca dehasāmyaṃ ca dṛksthitiḥ..102..
summary_line: The steps, in order, are described as follows: the control of the senses, the control of the mind, renunciation, silence, space, time, posture, the restraining root (Mulabandha), the equipoise of the body, the firmness of vision, the control of the vital forces, the withdrawal of the mind, concentration, self-contemplation and complete absorption.

आत्मध्यानं समाधिश्च प्रोक्तान्यङ्गानि वै क्रमात्।।103।।

Prāṇasaṃyamanaṃ caiva pratyāhāraśca dhāraṇā.
Ātmadhyānaṃ samādhiśca proktānyaṅgāni vai kramāt..103..

sanskrit_shloka:
सर्वं ब्रह्मेति विज्ञानादिन्द्रियग्रामसंयमः।
यमोऽयमिति संप्रोक्तोऽभ्यसनीयो मुहुर्मुहुः।।104।।
text:
सर्वं ब्रह्मेति विज्ञानादिन्द्रियग्रामसंयमः।
यमोऽयमिति संप्रोक्तोऽभ्यसनीयो मुहुर्मुहुः।।104।।
transliteration:
Sarvaṃ brahmeti vijñānādindriyagrāmasaṃyamaḥ.
Yamo'yamiti saṃprokto'bhyasanīyo muhurmuhuḥ..104..
summary_line: The restraint of all the senses by means of such knowledge as "All this is Brahman" is rightly called Yama, which should be practiced again and again.

sanskrit_shloka:
सजातीयप्रवाहश्च विजातीयतिरस्कृतिः।
नियमो हि परानन्दो नियमात्क्रियते बुधैः।।105।।
text:
सजातीयप्रवाहश्च विजातीयतिरस्कृतिः।
नियमो हि परानन्दो नियमात्क्रियते बुधैः।।105।।
transliteration:
Sajātīyapravāhaśca vijātīyatiraskṛtiḥ.
Niyamo hi parānando niyamātkriyate budhaiḥ..105..
summary_line: The continuous flow of only one kind of thought to the exclusion of all other thoughts, is called Niyama, which is verily the supreme bliss and is regularly practiced by the wise.

translations.author: Traditional Translation

sanskrit_shloka:
त्यागः प्रपञ्चरूपस्य चिदात्मत्वावलोकनात्।
त्यागो हि महतां पूज्यः सद्यो मोक्षमयो यतः।।106।।
text:
त्यागः प्रपञ्चरूपस्य चिदात्मत्वावलोकनात्।
त्यागो हि महतां पूज्यः सद्यो मोक्षमयो यतः।।106।।
transliteration:
Tyāgaḥ prapañcarūpasya cidātmatvāvalokanāt.
Tyāgo hi mahatāṃ pūjyaḥ sadyo mokṣamayo yataḥ..106..
summary_line: The abandonment of the illusory universe by realizing it as the all-conscious Atman is the real renunciation honored by the great, since it is of the nature of immediate liberation.

sanskrit_shloka:
यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते अप्राप्य मनसा सह।
यन्मौनं योगिभिर्गम्यं तद्भजेत्सर्वदा बुधः।।107।।
text:
यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते अप्राप्य मनसा सह।
यन्मौनं योगिभिर्गम्यं तद्भजेत्सर्वदा बुधः।।107।।
transliteration:
Yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha.
Yanmaunaṃ yogibhirgamyaṃ tadbhajetsarvadā budhaḥ..107..
summary_line: The wise should always be one with that silence wherefrom words together with the mind turn back without reaching it, but which is attainable by the Yogins.

translations.author: Traditional Translation

sanskrit_shloka:
वाचो यस्मान्निवर्तन्ते तद्वक्तुं केन शक्यते।
प्रपञ्चो यदि वक्तव्यः सोऽपि शब्दविवर्जितः।।108।।
text:
वाचो यस्मान्निवर्तन्ते तद्वक्तुं केन शक्यते।
प्रपञ्चो यदि वक्तव्यः सोऽपि शब्दविवर्जितः।।108।।
transliteration:
Vāco yasmānnivartante tadvaktuṃ kena śakyate.
Prapañco yadi vaktavyaḥ so'pi śabdavivarjitaḥ..108..
summary_line: Who can describe That (i.e., Brahman) whence words turn away ? (So silence is inevitable while describing Brahman). Or if the phenomenal world were to be described, even that is beyond words. This, to give an alternate definition, may also be termed silence known among the sages as congenital. The observance of silence by restraining speech, on the other hand, is ordained by the teachers of Brahman for the ignorant.

इति वा तद्भवेन्मौनं सतां सहजसंज्ञितम्।
गिरा मौनं तु बालानां प्रयुक्तं ब्रह्मवादिभिः।।109।।

Girā maunaṃ tu bālānāṃ prayuktaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ..109..

sanskrit_shloka:
आदावन्ते च मध्ये च जनो यस्मिन्न विद्यते।
येनेदं सततं व्याप्तं स देशो विजनः स्मृतः।।110।।
text:
आदावन्ते च मध्ये च जनो यस्मिन्न विद्यते।
येनेदं सततं व्याप्तं स देशो विजनः स्मृतः।।110।।
transliteration:
Ādāvante ca madhye ca jano yasminna vidyate.
Yenedaṃ satataṃ vyāptaṃ sa deśo vijanaḥ smṛtaḥ..110..
summary_line: That solitude is known as space, wherein the universe does not exist in the beginning, end or middle, but whereby it is pervaded at all times.

sanskrit_shloka:
कलनात्सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्मादीनां निमेषतः।
कालशब्देन निर्दिष्टो ह्यखण्डानन्द अद्वयः।।111।।
text:
कलनात्सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्मादीनां निमेषतः।
कालशब्देन निर्दिष्टो ह्यखण्डानन्द अद्वयः।।111।।
transliteration:
Kalanātsarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ nimeṣataḥ.
Kālaśabdena nirdiṣṭo hyakhaṇḍānanda advayaḥ..111..
summary_line: The non-dual (Brahman) that is bliss indivisible is denoted by the word'time', since it brings into existence, in the twinkling of an eye all beings from Brahman downwards.

sanskrit_shloka:
सुखेनैव भवेद्यस्मिन्नजस्रं ब्रह्मचिन्तनम्।
आसनं तद्विजानीयान्नेतरत्सुखनाशनम्।।112।।
text:
सुखेनैव भवेद्यस्मिन्नजस्रं ब्रह्मचिन्तनम्।
आसनं तद्विजानीयान्नेतरत्सुखनाशनम्।।112।।
transliteration:
Sukhenaiva bhavedyasminnajasraṃ brahmacintanam.
Āsanaṃ tadvijānīyānnetaratsukhanāśanam..112..
summary_line: One should known that as real posture in which the meditation on Brahman flows spontaneously and unceasingly, and not any other that destroys one's happiness.

सिद्धं यत्सर्वभूतादि विश्वाधिष्ठानमव्ययम्।
यस्मिन्सिद्धाः समाविष्टास्तद्वै सिद्धासनं विदुः।।113।।
text:
सिद्धं यत्सर्वभूतादि विश्वाधिष्ठानमव्ययम्।
यस्मिन्सिद्धाः समाविष्टास्तद्वै सिद्धासनं विदुः।।113।।

Siddhaṃ yatsarvabhūtādi viśvādhiṣṭhānamavyayam.
Yasminsiddhāḥ samāviṣṭāstadvai siddhāsanaṃ viduḥ..113..
summary_line: That which is well known as the origin of all beings and the support of the whole universe, which is immutable and in which the enlightened are completely merged � that alone is known as Siddhasana (eternal Brahman).

sanskrit_shloka:
यन्मूलं सर्वभूतानां यन्मूलं चित्तबन्धनम्।
मूलबन्धः सदा सेव्यो योगोऽसौ राजयोगिनाम्।।114।।
text:
यन्मूलं सर्वभूतानां यन्मूलं चित्तबन्धनम्।
मूलबन्धः सदा सेव्यो योगोऽसौ राजयोगिनाम्।।114।।
transliteration:
Yanmūlaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yanmūlaṃ cittabandhanam.
Mūlabandhaḥ sadā sevyo yogo'sau rājayoginām..114..
summary_line: That (Brahman) which is the root of all existence and on which the restraint of the mind is based is called the restraining root (Mulabandha) which should always be adopted since it is fit for Raja-yogins.

अङ्गानां समतां विद्यात्समे ब्रह्मणि लीयते।
नो चेन्नैव समानत्वमृजुत्वं शुष्कवृक्षवत्।।115।।
text:
अङ्गानां समतां विद्यात्समे ब्रह्मणि लीयते।
नो चेन्नैव समानत्वमृजुत्वं शुष्कवृक्षवत्।।115।।

Aṅgānāṃ samatāṃ vidyātsame brahmaṇi līyate.
No cennaiva samānatvamṛjutvaṃ śuṣkavṛkṣavat..115..
summary_line: Absorption in the uniform Brahman should be known as the equipoise of the limbs (Dehasamya). Otherwise mere straightening of the body like that of a dried-up tree is no equipoise.

सा दृष्टिः परमोदारा न नासाग्रावलोकनी।।116।।

summary_line: Converting the ordinary vision into one of knowledge one should view the world as Brahman itself. That is the noblest vision, and not that which is directed to the tip of the nose.

Draṣṭṛdarśanadṛśyānāṃ virāmo yatra vā bhavet.
Dṛṣṭistatraiva kartavyā na nāsāgrāvalokanī..117..
summary_line: Or, one should direct one's vision to That alone where all distinction of the seer, sight, and the seen ceases and not to the tip of the nose.

चित्तादिसर्वभावेषु ब्रह्मत्वेनैव भावनात्।
निरोधः सर्ववृत्तीनां प्राणायामः स उच्यते।।118।।
text:
चित्तादिसर्वभावेषु ब्रह्मत्वेनैव भावनात्।
निरोधः सर्ववृत्तीनां प्राणायामः स उच्यते।।118।।
transliteration:
Cittādisarvabhāveṣu brahmatvenaiva bhāvanāt.
Nirodhaḥ sarvavṛttīnāṃ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate..118..
summary_line: The restraint of all modifications of the mind by regarding all mental states like the Chitta as Brahman alone, is called Pranayama.

sanskrit_shloka:
निषेधनं प्रपञ्चस्य रेचकाख्यः समीरणः।
ब्रह्मैवास्मीति या वृत्तिः पूरको वायुरीरितः।।119।।
text:
निषेधनं प्रपञ्चस्य रेचकाख्यः समीरणः।
ब्रह्मैवास्मीति या वृत्तिः पूरको वायुरीरितः।।119।।
transliteration:
Niṣedhanaṃ prapañcasya recakākhyaḥ samīraṇaḥ.
Brahmaivāsmīti yā vṛttiḥ pūrako vāyurīritaḥ..119..
summary_line: The negation of the phenomenal world is known as Rechaka (breathing out), the thought, "I am verily Brahman", is called Puraka (breathing in), and the steadiness of that thought thereafter is called Kumbhaka (restraining the breath). This is the real course of Pranayama for the enlightened, whereas the ignorant only torture the nose.

sanskrit_shloka:
ततस्तद्वृत्तिनैश्चल्यं कुम्भकः प्राणसंयमः।
अयं चापि प्रबुद्धानामज्ञानां घ्राणपीडनम्।।120।।

Tatastadvṛttinaiścalyaṃ kumbhakaḥ prāṇasaṃyamaḥ.
Ayaṃ cāpi prabuddhānāmajñānāṃ ghrāṇapīḍanam..120..

sanskrit_shloka:
विषयेष्वात्मतां दृष्ट्वा मनसश्चिति मज्जनम्।
प्रत्याहारः स विज्ञेयोऽभ्यसनीयो मुमुक्षुभिः।।121।।
text:
विषयेष्वात्मतां दृष्ट्वा मनसश्चिति मज्जनम्।
प्रत्याहारः स विज्ञेयोऽभ्यसनीयो मुमुक्षुभिः।।121।।
transliteration:
Viṣayeṣvātmatāṃ dṛṣṭvā manasaściti majjanam.
Pratyāhāraḥ sa vijñeyo'bhyasanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ..121..
summary_line: The absorption of the mind in the Supreme Consciousness by realizing Atman in all objects is known as Pratyahara (withdrawal of the mind) which should be practiced by the seekers after liberation.

sanskrit_shloka:
यत्र यत्र मनो याति ब्रह्मणस्तत्र दर्शनात्।
मनसो धारणायैव धारणा सा परा मता।।122।।
text:
यत्र यत्र मनो याति ब्रह्मणस्तत्र दर्शनात्।
मनसो धारणायैव धारणा सा परा मता।।122।।
transliteration:
Yatra yatra mano yāti brahmaṇastatra darśanāt.
Manaso dhāraṇāyaiva dhāraṇā sā parā matā..122..
summary_line: The steadiness of the mind through realization of Brahman wherever the mind goes, is known as the supreme Dharana (concentration).

sanskrit_shloka:
ब्रह्मैवास्मीति सद्वृत्त्या निरालम्बतया स्थितिः।
ध्यानशब्देन विख्याता परमानन्ददायिनी।।123।।
text:
ब्रह्मैवास्मीति सद्वृत्त्या निरालम्बतया स्थितिः।
ध्यानशब्देन विख्याता परमानन्ददायिनी।।123।।
transliteration:
Brahmaivāsmīti sadvṛttyā nirālambatayā sthitiḥ.
Dhyānaśabdena vikhyātā paramānandadāyinī..123..
summary_line: Remaining independent of everything as a result of the unassailable thought, "I am verily Brahman", is well known by the word Dhyana (meditation), and is productive of supreme bliss.

निर्विकारतया वृत्त्या ब्रह्माकारतया पुनः।
वृत्तिविस्मरणं सम्यक्समाधिर्ज्ञानसंज्ञकः।।124।।
text:
निर्विकारतया वृत्त्या ब्रह्माकारतया पुनः।
वृत्तिविस्मरणं सम्यक्समाधिर्ज्ञानसंज्ञकः।।124।।

Nirvikāratayā vṛttyā brahmākāratayā punaḥ.
Vṛttivismaraṇaṃ samyaksamādhirjñānasaṃjñakaḥ..124..
summary_line: The complete forgetfulness of all thought by first making it changeless and then identifying it with Brahman is called Samadhi known also as knowledge.

sanskrit_shloka:
एवं चाकृत्रिमानन्दं तावत्साधु समभ्यसेत्।
वश्यो यावत्क्षणात्पुंसः प्रयुक्तः स भेवत्स्वयम्।।125।।
text:
एवं चाकृत्रिमानन्दं तावत्साधु समभ्यसेत्।
वश्यो यावत्क्षणात्पुंसः प्रयुक्तः स भेवत्स्वयम्।।125।।
transliteration:
Evaṃ cākṛtrimānandaṃ tāvatsādhu samabhyaset.
Vaśyo yāvatkṣaṇātpuṃsaḥ prayuktaḥ sa bhevatsvayam..125..
summary_line: The aspirant should carefully practice this (meditation) that reveals his natural bliss until, being under his full control, it arises spontaneously, in an instant when called into action.

sanskrit_shloka:
ततः साधननिर्मुक्तः सिद्धो भवति योगिराट्।
तत्स्वरूपं न चैकस्य विषयो मनसो गिराम्।।126।।
text:
ततः साधननिर्मुक्तः सिद्धो भवति योगिराट्।
तत्स्वरूपं न चैकस्य विषयो मनसो गिराम्।।126।।
transliteration:
Tataḥ sādhananirmuktaḥ siddho bhavati yogirāṭ.
Tatsvarūpaṃ na caikasya viṣayo manaso girām..126..
summary_line: Then he, the best among Yogis having attained to perfection, becomes free from all practices. The real nature of such a man never becomes an object of the mind or speech.

sanskrit_shloka:
समाधौ क्रियमाणे तु विघ्ना आयान्ति वै बलात्।
अनुसंधानराहित्यमालस्यं भोगलालसम्।।127।।
text:
समाधौ क्रियमाणे तु विघ्ना आयान्ति वै बलात्।
अनुसंधानराहित्यमालस्यं भोगलालसम्।।127।।
transliteration:
Samādhau kriyamāṇe tu vighnā āyānti vai balāt.
Anusaṃdhānarāhityamālasyaṃ bhogalālasam..127..
summary_line: While practicing Samadhi there appear unavoidably many obstacles, such as lack of inquiry, idleness, desire for sense-pleasure, sleep, dullness, distraction, tasting of joy, and the sense of blankness. One desiring the knowledge of Brahman should slowly get rid of such innumerable obstacles.

लयस्तमश्च विक्षेपो रसास्वादश्च शून्यता।
एवं यद्विघ्नबाहुल्यं त्याज्यं ब्रह्मविदा शनैः।।128।।

Evaṃ yadvighnabāhulyaṃ tyājyaṃ brahmavidā śanaiḥ..128..

भाववृत्त्या हि भावत्वं शून्यवृत्त्या हि शून्यता।
ब्रह्मवृत्त्या हि पूर्णत्वं तथा पूर्णत्वमभ्यसेत्।।129।।
text:
भाववृत्त्या हि भावत्वं शून्यवृत्त्या हि शून्यता।
ब्रह्मवृत्त्या हि पूर्णत्वं तथा पूर्णत्वमभ्यसेत्।।129।।

Bhāvavṛttyā hi bhāvatvaṃ śūnyavṛttyā hi śūnyatā.
Brahmavṛttyā hi pūrṇatvaṃ tathā pūrṇatvamabhyaset..129..
summary_line: While thinking of an object the mind verily identifies itself with that, and while thinking of a void it really becomes blank, whereas by the thought of Brahman it attains to perfection. So one should constantly think of (Brahman to attain) perfection.

ये हि वृत्तिं जहत्येनां ब्रह्माख्यां पावनीं पराम्।

ये हि वृत्तिं जहत्येनां ब्रह्माख्यां पावनीं पराम्।
वृथैव ते तु जीवन्ति पशुभिश्च समा नराः।।130।।

ते वै सत्पुरुषा धन्या वन्द्यास्ते भुवनत्रये।।131।।

ये हि वृत्तिं विजानन्ति ये ज्ञात्वा वर्धयन्त्यपि।

Te vai satpuruṣā dhanyā vandyāste bhuvanatraye..131..

ते वै सद्ब्रह्मतां प्राप्ता नेतरे शब्दवादिनः।।132।।

sanskrit_shloka:
निमेषार्धं न तिष्ठन्ति वृत्तिं ब्रह्ममयीं विना।
यथा तिष्ठन्ति ब्रह्माद्याः सनकाद्याः शुकादयः।।134।।
text:
निमेषार्धं न तिष्ठन्ति वृत्तिं ब्रह्ममयीं विना।
यथा तिष्ठन्ति ब्रह्माद्याः सनकाद्याः शुकादयः।।134।।
transliteration:
Nimeṣārdhaṃ na tiṣṭhanti vṛttiṃ brahmamayīṃ vinā.
Yathā tiṣṭhanti brahmādyāḥ sanakādyāḥ śukādayaḥ..134..
summary_line: The aspirants after Brahman should not remain a single moment without the thought of Brahman, just like Brahma, Sanaka, Suka and others.

sanskrit_shloka:
कार्ये कारणतायाता कारणे न हि कार्यता।
कारणत्वं स्वतो गच्छेत्कार्याभावे विचारतः।।135।।
text:
कार्ये कारणतायाता कारणे न हि कार्यता।
कारणत्वं स्वतो गच्छेत्कार्याभावे विचारतः।।135।।
transliteration:
Kārye kāraṇatāyātā kāraṇe na hi kāryatā.
Kāraṇatvaṃ svato gacchetkāryābhāve vicārataḥ..135..
summary_line: The nature of the cause inheres in the effect and not vice versa; so through reasoning it is found that in the absence of the effect, the cause, as such also disappears.

sanskrit_shloka:
अथ शुद्धं भवेद्वस्तु यद्वै वाचामगोचरः।
द्रष्टव्यं मृद्धटेनैव दृष्टान्तेन पुनः पुनः।।136।।
text:
अथ शुद्धं भवेद्वस्तु यद्वै वाचामगोचरः।
द्रष्टव्यं मृद्धटेनैव दृष्टान्तेन पुनः पुनः।।136।।
transliteration:
Atha śuddhaṃ bhavedvastu yadvai vācāmagocaraḥ.
Draṣṭavyaṃ mṛddhaṭenaiva dṛṣṭāntena punaḥ punaḥ..136..
summary_line: Then that pure reality (Brahman) which is beyond speech alone remains. This should be understood again and again verily through the illustration of earth and the pot.

sanskrit_shloka:
अनेनैव प्रकारेण वृत्तिर्ब्रह्मात्मिका भवेत्।
उदेति शुद्धचित्तानां वृत्तिज्ञानं ततः परम्।।137।।
text:
अनेनैव प्रकारेण वृत्तिर्ब्रह्मात्मिका भवेत्।
उदेति शुद्धचित्तानां वृत्तिज्ञानं ततः परम्।।137।।
transliteration:
Anenaiva prakāreṇa vṛttirbrahmātmikā bhavet.
Udeti śuddhacittānāṃ vṛttijñānaṃ tataḥ param..137..
summary_line: In this way alone there arises in the pure-minded a state of awareness (of Brahman), which is afterwards merged into Brahman.

translations.author: Traditional Translation

sanskrit_shloka:
कारणं व्यतिरेकेण पुमानादौ विलोकयेत्।
अन्वयेन पुनस्तद्धि कार्ये नित्यं प्रपश्यति।।138।।
text:
कारणं व्यतिरेकेण पुमानादौ विलोकयेत्।
अन्वयेन पुनस्तद्धि कार्ये नित्यं प्रपश्यति।।138।।
transliteration:
Kāraṇaṃ vyatirekeṇa pumānādau vilokayet.
Anvayena punastaddhi kārye nityaṃ prapaśyati..138..
summary_line: One should first look for the cause by the negative method and then find it by the positive method, as ever inherent in the effect.

translations.author: Traditional Translation

sanskrit_shloka:
कार्ये हि कारणं पश्येत्पश्चात्कार्यं विसर्जयेत्।
कारणत्वं स्वतो नश्येदवशिष्टं भवेन्मुनिः।।139।।
text:
कार्ये हि कारणं पश्येत्पश्चात्कार्यं विसर्जयेत्।
कारणत्वं स्वतो नश्येदवशिष्टं भवेन्मुनिः।।139।।
transliteration:
Kārye hi kāraṇaṃ paśyetpaścātkāryaṃ visarjayet.
Kāraṇatvaṃ svato naśyedavaśiṣṭaṃ bhavenmuniḥ..139..
summary_line: One should verily see the cause in the effect, and then dismiss the effect altogether. What then remains, the sage himself becomes.

translations.author: Traditional Translation

sanskrit_shloka:
भावितं तीव्रवेगेण वस्तु यन्निश्चयात्मना।
पुमांस्तद्धि भवेच्छीघ्रं ज्ञेयं भ्रमरकीटवत्।।140।।
text:
भावितं तीव्रवेगेण वस्तु यन्निश्चयात्मना।
पुमांस्तद्धि भवेच्छीघ्रं ज्ञेयं भ्रमरकीटवत्।।140।।
transliteration:
Bhāvitaṃ tīvravegeṇa vastu yanniścayātmanā.
Pumāṃstaddhi bhavecchīghraṃ jñeyaṃ bhramarakīṭavat..140..
summary_line: A person who meditates upon a thing with great assiduity and firm conviction, becomes that very thing. This may be understood from the illustration of the wasp and the worm.

sanskrit_shloka:
अदृश्यं भावरूपं च सर्वमेतच्चिदात्मकम्।
सावधानतया नित्यं स्वात्मानं भावयेद्बुधः।।141।।
text:
अदृश्यं भावरूपं च सर्वमेतच्चिदात्मकम्।
सावधानतया नित्यं स्वात्मानं भावयेद्बुधः।।141।।
transliteration:
Adṛśyaṃ bhāvarūpaṃ ca sarvametaccidātmakam.
Sāvadhānatayā nityaṃ svātmānaṃ bhāvayedbudhaḥ..141..
summary_line: The wise should always think with great care of the invisible, the visible, and everything else, as his own Self which is consciousness itself.

sanskrit_shloka:
दृश्यं ह्यदृश्यतां नीत्वा ब्रह्माकारेण चिन्तयेत्।
विद्वान्नित्यसुखे तिष्ठेद्धिया चिद्रसपूर्णया।।142।।
text:
दृश्यं ह्यदृश्यतां नीत्वा ब्रह्माकारेण चिन्तयेत्।
विद्वान्नित्यसुखे तिष्ठेद्धिया चिद्रसपूर्णया।।142।।

Dṛśyaṃ hyadṛśyatāṃ nītvā brahmākāreṇa cintayet.
Vidvānnityasukhe tiṣṭheddhiyā cidrasapūrṇayā..142..
summary_line: Having reduced the visible to the invisible, the wise should think of the universe as one with Brahman. Thus alone will he abide in eternal felicity with mind full of consciousness and bliss.

sanskrit_shloka:
एभिरङ्गैः समायुक्तो राजयोग उदाहृतः।
किंचित्पक्वकषायाणां हठयोगेन संयुतः।।143।।

परिपक्वं मनो येषां केवलोऽयं च सिद्धिदः।
गुरुदैवतभक्तानां सर्वेषां सुलभो जवात्।।144।।

परिपक्वं मनो येषां केवलोऽयं च सिद्धिदः।
गुरुदैवतभक्तानां सर्वेषां सुलभो जवात्।।144।।

summary_line: For those whose mind is completely purified this (Raja-Yoga) alone is productive of perfection. Purity of the mind, again, is speedily accessible to those who are devoted to the teacher and the Deity.
